quarterly_data.signal: Flex's Cloud and Power Infrastructure segment is Axiom Solutions International, Inc. (Axiom); Flex intends to separate Axiom into an independent, publicly traded company in the first quarter of calendar 2027, subject to customary conditions, and the pending EPC Power acquisition is Axiom's (financing terms excluded).
